cohort: The study analyzed data from women in Bangladesh who had institutional deliveries, collected through Bangladesh Demographic and Health Surveys for 2011, 2014, 2017-18, and 2022.
finding: Women from communities with a high prevalence of C-sections were 11.68 times more likely, and women delivering in private facilities were 8.16 times more likely, to have a C-section in their last birth compared to their respective counterparts.
cross-section timing: Data from Bangladesh Demographic and Health Surveys (BDHS) for 2011, 2014, 2017-18, and 2022.
